title: The Bridge, the Budget, and the Bus Lane · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short letter (about 120–150 words) to your local council about a transport problem in your area. Describe the problem, give two possible solutions, and explain which solution you prefer and why. Use passive forms and causal expressions where possible.
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
